checkout.billingDetails.disclaimer.befor: By signing up for a subscription or starting a {trialDays}-day free trial, you authorize us to charge your card on file {price}/year USD. Your subscription will automatically renew each year until you cancel. The price for your subscription may change. Cancel anytime by visiting the Subscription Management page. Refunds and credits are not available. You must cancel your subscription before the subscription renewal date in order to avoid charges for the next billing cycle. Cancelling a subscription stops the annual recurring subscription charge, but does not refund the transaction for the current billing period. You can continue to access the subscription until the end of the then-current billing period
